questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: RA 11148 (Kalusugan at Nutrisyon ng Mag-Nanay Act) focuses on health and nutrition during the:
questions.rationale: RA 11148 scales up health and nutrition for the first 1,000 days: pregnancy to 24 months.
questions.source: RA 11148, Kalusugan at Nutrisyon ng Mag-Nanay Act, Sec. 4 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Scaling Up Health and Nutrition for the First One Thousand (1,000) Days of Life

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Under RA 11148, children are covered from birth up to what age?
questions.rationale: Coverage includes all Filipino children newly born up to 24 months, plus at-risk pregnant and lactating women.
questions.source: RA 11148, Kalusugan at Nutrisyon ng Mag-Nanay Act, Sec. 5 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: all Filipino children who are newly born up to age twenty-four (24) months

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which prenatal service is listed under RA 11148?
questions.rationale: Prenatal services include micronutrients (iron, folic acid, calcium, iodine), Td immunization, deworming and nutrition counseling.
questions.source: RA 11148, Kalusugan at Nutrisyon ng Mag-Nanay Act, Sec. 8(a) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Provision of micronutrient supplements such as iron, folic acid, calcium, iodine

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Under RA 11148, lactation support for mothers continues from birth up to:
questions.rationale: Lactation support and counseling is from birth up to 2 years and beyond, including working mothers.
questions.source: RA 11148, Kalusugan at Nutrisyon ng Mag-Nanay Act, Sec. 8(c) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Lactation support and counselling from birth up to two (2) years and beyond

questions.subject: NP II
questions.topic: Care of the Well Child (Neonate to Adolescent)
questions.stem: For a preterm, low-birth-weight baby, RA 11148 calls for:
questions.rationale: Early skin-to-skin contact for term babies and continuous kangaroo mother care for preterm/LBW babies.
questions.source: RA 11148, Kalusugan at Nutrisyon ng Mag-Nanay Act, Sec. 8(d) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: continuous kangaroo mother care for small babies born preterm and low birth weight

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: A formula company offers free samples for mothers in the ward. Under the Milk Code, the nurse should:
questions.rationale: Manufacturers may not give samples or gifts to the public, mothers or health facilities.
questions.source: EO 51, Milk Code of the Philippines (1986), Sec. 6(b) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: shall not be permitted to give, directly, or indirectly, samples and supplies of products within the scope of this Code

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which is a Milk Code violation in a health center?
questions.rationale: Health facilities may not display products or posters of products covered by the Code.
questions.source: EO 51, Milk Code of the Philippines (1986), Sec. 7(c) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Facilities of the health care system shall not be used for the display of products within the scope of this Code

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which label wording is banned on infant formula under the Milk Code?
questions.rationale: Terms like 'humanized' or 'maternalized' are prohibited because they idealize formula.
questions.source: EO 51, Milk Code of the Philippines (1986), Sec. 10(d) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: The term "humanized", maternalized" or similar terms shall not be used.

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: A sari-sari store sells infant formula by the cup from an opened can. This is:
questions.rationale: Outlets, including sari-sari stores, may not open cans to retail by the cup to prevent contamination.
questions.source: EO 51, Milk Code of the Philippines (1986), Sec. 11(c) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: shall not be allowed to open cans and boxes for the purpose of retailing them by the cup

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Under RA 11210, how many days of paid maternity leave does a worker get for a live birth?
questions.rationale: 105 days with full pay, regardless of delivery type, with an option of 30 more days unpaid.
questions.source: RA 11210, 105-Day Expanded Maternity Leave Law, Sec. 3 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: shall be granted one hundred five (105) days maternity leave with full pay

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: A nurse had a miscarriage at 10 weeks. Under RA 11210 she is entitled to:
questions.rationale: Miscarriage or emergency termination of pregnancy: 60 days with full pay.
questions.source: RA 11210, 105-Day Expanded Maternity Leave Law, Sec. 3 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: for cases of miscarriage or emergency termination of pregnancy, sixty (60) days maternity leave with full pay shall be granted

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Under RA 11210, a mother may transfer how many of her leave days to the child's father?
questions.rationale: She may allocate up to 7 days to the child's father, married to her or not.
questions.source: RA 11210, 105-Day Expanded Maternity Leave Law, Sec. 6 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: allocate up to seven (7) days of said benefits to the child's father

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Under RA 7610, a 'child' is a person:
questions.rationale: Children are below 18, or over 18 but unable to protect themselves because of disability.
questions.source: RA 7610, Special Protection of Children Against Abuse Act, Sec. 3(a) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: "Children" refers to person below eighteen (18) years of age

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: A 14-year-old is brought to the ER after stealing. Under RA 9344, he is:
questions.rationale: A child 15 or under is exempt from criminal liability but undergoes an intervention program.
questions.source: RA 9344, Juvenile Justice and Welfare Act of 2006, Sec. 6 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: A child fifteen (15) years of age or under at the time of the commission of the offense shall be exempt from criminal liability.

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Under RA 9344, a 16-year-old may face court proceedings only if he:
questions.rationale: Above 15 but below 18 is exempt unless acting with discernment.
questions.source: RA 9344, Juvenile Justice and Welfare Act of 2006, Sec. 6 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: unless he/she has acted with discernment

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Under RA 11648, the age of sexual consent in the Philippines is:
questions.rationale: RA 11648 (2022) raised the age to 16; sex with a child under 16 is statutory rape, with a narrow close-in-age exception.
questions.source: RA 11648 (2022), amending the Revised Penal Code, Art. 266-A (Lawphil)
questions.quote: When the offended party is under sixteen (16) years of age

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Under RA 10152, which vaccine is given to all infants born in facilities with obstetric services?
questions.rationale: Hepatitis B vaccine is given to infants born in hospitals, infirmaries, health and lying-in centers.
questions.source: RA 10152, Mandatory Infants and Children Health Immunization Act of 2011, Sec. 3 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Hepatitis-B vaccine shall be administered by any duly licensed physician, nurse or midwife to all infants born in hospitals

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Under RA 10152, free basic immunization at government facilities covers children up to:
questions.rationale: Mandatory basic immunization is free for infants and children up to 5 years.
questions.source: RA 10152, Mandatory Infants and Children Health Immunization Act of 2011, Sec. 3 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: given for free at any government hospital or health center to infants and children up to five (5) years of age

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Parents refuse newborn hearing screening for religious reasons. Under RA 9709, the nurse should:
questions.rationale: Parents may refuse on religious or cultural grounds but must acknowledge in writing that they were informed of the risks.
questions.source: RA 9709, Universal Newborn Hearing Screening Act of 2009, Sec. 7 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: shall acknowledge in writing that they have been informed of their responsibility to perform said screening

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Under RA 9709, when should a hospital-born infant have hearing screening?
questions.rationale: All hospital-born infants undergo hearing loss screening before discharge unless parents object.
questions.source: RA 9709, Universal Newborn Hearing Screening Act of 2009, Sec. 6 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: shall be made to undergo newborn hearing loss screening before discharge

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: A nurse suspects a woman's injuries are from her husband. Under RA 9262, the nurse must:
options: Wait for the woman to file
questions.rationale: Healthcare providers must document injuries, record observations, give a free medical certificate and inform her of rights.
questions.source: RA 9262, Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act of 2004, Sec. 31 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: properly document any of the victim's physical, emotional or psychological injuries

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: Under RA 9262, how much does a medical certificate cost an abused woman?
questions.rationale: Providers must automatically give the victim a medical certificate free of charge.
questions.source: RA 9262, Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act of 2004, Sec. 31(c) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: automatically provide the victim free of charge a medical certificate

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: Who issues a Barangay Protection Order, and how long does it last?
questions.rationale: The Punong Barangay (or a kagawad if unavailable) issues a BPO effective for 15 days.
questions.source: RA 9262, Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act of 2004, Sec. 14 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: BPOs shall be effective for fifteen (15) days.

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: Under RA 9262, how many days of paid leave may a VAWC survivor take?
questions.rationale: Victims are entitled to up to 10 days paid leave, extendible as specified in the protection order.
questions.source: RA 9262, Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act of 2004, Sec. 43 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: entitled to take a paid leave of absence up to ten (10) days
